ContractScribe CLI

Usage:
  contract-scribe [--help | --version | doctor]
  contract-scribe audit --repository-root <path> --input <path> --policy <path> --output <path>
  contract-scribe campaign start --repository-root <path> --input <path> --policy <path> --snapshot <binding> --state <path> --configuration <path>
  contract-scribe campaign resume --repository-root <path> --input <path> --policy <path> --snapshot <binding> --state <path> --configuration <path>

Commands:
  audit       Run the deterministic XML documentation audit.
  campaign    Start or resume a durable documentation campaign.
  doctor      Print an allowlisted local runtime diagnostic without network or credential access.

Options:
  -h, --help      Print this help.
  -v, --version   Print the tool version.
